Switchless B10100 topology (direct-attached, no backend NVMe-oF switches): uberSKUs S0B84A (HPE Alletra STG MP B10100 Base Config), S0U38A (HPE Alletra STG MP B10100 Up Config), S3V89A (HPE GL Prv Cld w/AL STG MP Base Config), S3V90A (HPE GL Prv Cld w/AL STG MP Upg Config); controller chassis R7C75A hosts up to 24 internal NVMe SSDs; expansion uses S1J10A JBOF shelves (2x S1R28A). Nodes: B10120 [S0S38A, 8c, JBOF 0-1, maxDrives=24, maxTotal=24]; B10130 [S0R21A, 16c, JBOF 0-3, maxDrives=24, maxTotal=72]; B10140 [S4V66A, 32c, JBOF 0-3, maxDrives=24, maxTotal=72].
